how_to_apply: Register on the apprenticeship portal: Interested eligible candidates must first register at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in for enrolment as an Apprentice. Applications will not be accepted without this registration and the unique registration number it generates.

Complete Aadhaar verification: Complete Aadhaar verification of the enrolment on the apprenticeshipindia.gov.in portal, and attach a screenshot of the "Aadhaar verified" status (hard copy) along with the application. The Unique Enrolment ID must be provided in the application; applications missing this will not be processed further.

Download the application form: Download the Application Form (Annexure-I) from the BHAVINI website, bhavini.nic.in. Before applying, candidates should confirm their eligibility for the specific trade they are applying for.

Fill and prepare the application: The application should be submitted in the prescribed proforma, preferably typed on A4-size paper. The outer cover should be superscribed: "APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT OF TRADE APPRENTICE against Notice No. BHAVINI/HR/TA-V/2026-2027".
Attach self-attested documents: Enclose self-attested photocopies of the required certificates (listed in the Documents Required section below).

Send the application by post: Send the duly filled application, with a passport-size photograph affixed, to: Deputy General Manager (HR), Recruitment Section, Bharatiya Nabhikiya Vidyut Nigam Limited (BHAVINI), Kalpakkam - 603102, Chengalpattu District, Tamil Nadu.
Meet the deadline: The filled-in application must reach BHAVINI on or before 1 October 2026. Applications received after this date will not be considered for any reason.

Note: While enrolment and Aadhaar verification are completed online on the apprenticeship portal, the final application form itself is submitted physically by post to BHAVINI's office - the notification does not provide an online submission link for the application form.

content_sections.heading: General Conditions
content_sections.text: Candidates should submit only one application, in the prescribed format only. Candidates who have already undergone Apprenticeship Training, partially or fully, for one year or more in any discipline need not apply. Candidates selected for training will not be allowed to withdraw except for reasons beyond their control; those who leave on their own are liable to refund the full cost of training and the stipend received. Every apprentice who completes the training period must pass a test conducted by the National Council for Training in Vocational Trades to receive a Certificate of Proficiency. There is no obligation on BHAVINI to provide employment to apprentices on completion of their training. Management reserves the right to cancel or alter the number of seats in a particular trade, or the entire engagement process, without assigning any reason. Preference will be given to applicants belonging to villages neighbouring the plant site; such local candidates must produce valid identity proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID/Driving Licence/Ration Card) at the time of document verification. Incomplete applications, or those without the required self-attested certificate copies, are liable to be rejected without any communication. As BHAVINI is a highly protected area, apprentices will be allowed to join only after submitting a Police Verification Certificate from a Sub-Inspector or higher officer.

faq.question: Q1. What is BHAVINI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Bharatiya Nabhikiya Vidyut Nigam Limited (BHAVINI) to engage 50 Trade Apprentices across nine ITI trades at Kalpakkam, Tamil Nadu, under Notice No. BHAVINI/HR/TA-V/2026-2027, on a one-year, stipend-based apprenticeship.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BHAVINI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 50 vacancies in total, distributed across nine trades: Fitter (10), Machinist (1), Digital Photographer/Photographer (1), Maintenance Mechanic (Chemical Plant)/Fitter (10), Computer Operator and Programming Assistant (3), Instrument Mechanic (10), Electrician (10), Mechanic Refrigeration and Air Conditioning (3), and Draughtsman (Mechanical) (2).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BHAVINI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the filled-in application is 1 October 2026. Applications received after this date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for BHAVINI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by trade, but generally requires a 10th class pass (with Science and Mathematics for most trades) under the 10+2 system or its equivalent, along with an ITI Pass Certificate in the relevant trade. See the qualification table above for trade-specific details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BHAVINI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be less than 16 years old. The maximum age limit is 24 years for General and EWS candidates, with relaxation of up to 5 years for SC, up to 3 years for OBC (NCL), and up to 10 years for PWBD candidates, as on 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for BHAVINI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register and complete Aadhaar verification online at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. However, the completed application form itself must be downloaded from the BHAVINI website, filled in, and sent by post to the Deputy General Manager (HR), Recruitment Section, BHAVINI, Kalpakkam - 603102, Chengalpattu District, Tamil Nadu, so it reaches on or before 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BHAVINI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves shortlisting based on ITI marks and trade competency, followed by a Trade Test/Certificate Verification, a medical examination, and Police Verification before joining the training.

faq.question: Q8. What is the stipend for BHAVINI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected apprentices receive a minimum stipend of Rs. 9,600/- per month, for those engaged after a one-year ITI course, during the one-year training period.
